programs.description: Narayanankutty boasts that he is Mala's fiancé, the daughter of a rich businessman. Things take a turn when she approaches him in the guise of a news reporter and asks him about this affair.
Udayan is crowned to rule over his uncle's kingdom. While he strives to handle the responsibility, he attempts to overcome challenges of people who are against his accession.
